messages.subject: dateInput with always-present calendar view
parts:
Anyone know if there's a simple way to force dateInput to present the calendar view at all times (as opposed to only showing the calendar during selection)?
Example: the "inline" version of jQuery-UI's Datepicker widget: http://jqueryui.com/datepicker/#inline

Cheers,

-Murat
